item.body:
### Summary
As a member on iPhone, I want a setting that chooses whether the composer opens full screen or as the small card docked on the keyboard, so that each member gets the layout they prefer. Default: full screen, as legacy.

### Requested (operator, 2026-11-12)
- Some members will prefer the full-screen composer, others the small docked card: let them choose.
- **Default = legacy: full screen** (`MessagesView.swift:5429-5443`, `coverVerticalFullScreen` @ 87fe0d1c).
- Whatever the setting, the existing control that switches the height stays: from full screen, it still shrinks the composer to the card floating above the keyboard, and back.

### Today
- `App/SwiftHFR/Composer/ComposerHeight.swift:3-12, 26-35`: on an iPhone in regular height every composer (reply, edit, new topic, new MP) opens at `.partial`, or `.full` at an accessibility text size; the height chosen with the toggle is not remembered (operator, 2026-11-10). This issue replaces "every opening starts at partial height" with "every opening starts at the height of the setting".
- Partial height is a (b) evolution (GAP-653).

### Scope
- A new setting, in Réglages next to the reply "+" behaviour (`TopicsSettingsModel.swift:33-35`, `reply_button_behavior`): e.g. « Éditeur de réponse : Plein écran / Compact » (French labels to confirm in the spec). iPhone only: hidden on iPad and wherever `ComposerHeight.offersToggle` is false.
- New `SettingKey` (no legacy counterpart), default full; its scope in the ADR 0013 matrix to decide in the spec (it follows the device's screen, so `.device` is the likely fit).
- `ComposerHeight.shown(chosen:…)` takes the setting as the starting height when nothing was chosen; accessibility text sizes keep opening full (#749 decision).
- Ledger: a `gap-edit` of GAP-653 in the PR's `### Ledger` (default back to legacy, compact as an option).

### Acceptance criteria
- Fresh install on iPhone: the composer opens full screen; the toggle shrinks it to the docked card and back.
- Setting on "compact": every composer opens as the docked card, as today; the toggle still expands it.
- At an accessibility text size, it opens full whatever the setting. iPad and iPhone landscape (compact height): unchanged, no setting shown.
- Tests: `ComposerHeight.shown` for each setting × text size × device; the setting key in `SettingKeyTests` / `SettingScopeTests`; shown to fail without the change.
- Related: #853, #854 (composer feedback of the same day), #749 / #653.

comments.body:
Addition (operator, 2026-11-13): **dragging the half-height composer up switches it to full screen**, as the expand button does. Dragging it back down (or the reduce button) returns it to half height above the keyboard.

Acceptance:
- [ ] At half height, an upward drag on the composer's grabber or header goes to full screen (same state as the expand button).
- [ ] At full screen, a downward drag returns to half height. Closing stays a separate gesture, so a drag never discards the draft.
- [ ] The text, focus and cursor are kept across the switch.

Today a drag on the composer only dismisses the keyboard (#853 observation).
